summary: Add inactive raw-pipe holder gate and transient user keeper adapter (unit 7c)

rules.detail: Admission is not wired. No startup or launch caller. Gate EOF, short reads and non-release bytes abort with _exit before any holder exec; the pre_exec gate uses raw async-signal-safe IO only.

compatibility.detail: Only the shared keeper uses user-manager StartTransientUnit with PIDs, configured Slice, Delegate, MemoryAccounting, TasksAccounting and optional IOAccounting. No BindsTo or PartOf. Its pause-only process closes all FDs and is independent of daemon lifetime. Fixtures cover EOF/no-exec and explicit release; property tests prohibit daemon lifetime dependencies.

downtime.detail: No live behavior or deployment changes.

manual.detail: No activation or policy defaults. The daemon-delegated mkdir alternative was rejected because it required deployment changes.

recovery.detail: Unit 8 owns restart decisions. Keeper child reaping does not stop a live keeper when the adapter or daemon exits.
